Profile Summary 
Results-driven Business Analyst with over 8 years of experience across Banking, Capital Markets, and Financial 
Services domains, driving digital transformation, process optimization, and automation initiatives. Proven 
expertise in Loan Origination Systems (LOS), Trade Finance, and Core Banking Solutions with hands-on 
Experience in Requirement Elicitation, Gap Analysis, Agile Delivery, and Stakeholder Management. Skilled in 
preparing BRD, FRD, User Stories, Process Flows, and Traceability Matrices to ensure alignment between 
business needs and technical delivery. Adept at managing end-to-end SDLC, collaborating with cross-functional 
teams, and conducting UAT and functional testing to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions. Proficient in JIRA, 
Confluence, Power BI, SQL, and API Postman, with a consistent track record of improving efficiency, enhancing 
user adoption, and enabling data-driven decision-making.
